contrary_evidence: NBER 1998 finds no evidence Soros or large currency hedge funds caused 1997 Asian crash.
GSQ 2021 finds no detectable macro effects of OSF grants on measured democratic outcomes and no evidence for claims of protest/migration destabilization.
2000 technology losses contradict the claim of investment infallibility.
Dated UK central-bank record shows the sterling regime was under macroeconomic pressure before a single fund's trades.
limitations: Past returns, fund AUM, personal assets, endowment and annual grants are distinct measures.
OSF geographic spending data are organization-reported; peer-reviewed causal evidence remains limited and mixed.
Attribution of political impacts requires specific filings, grants, recipient actions and comparative outcomes.
Secondary media reports of 1992 profit and 2000 financial losses are distinguished from official accounting.

producer_checks.information_cutoff: 24 October 2026. OSF 2024 regional expenditure and November 2025 fact sheet; Soros Fund Management current firm description; FactCheck August 2026 based on FEC June 30 reports; historic Bank of England, ECtHR, NBER and scholarly record.
producer_checks.editorial_novelty: First sustained individual biography of George Soros for actor research; economic, personal, intellectual, political and philanthropic institutions separated; distinct from BlackRock or IMF organizational actor dossiers.
producer_checks.visual_signature: Two bilingual identical numeric OSF charts with units and vintage, two substantial comparison tables, one causal flow and one qualitative geography map.
producer_checks.source_check: 22 identical institutional, scholarly, court and quality-journalism references; Bank of England 1992, NBER 1998, ECtHR 2011, OUP 2021, OECD 2025, OSF 2024/2025, FEC-linked FactCheck 2026. Primary and secondary separated.
producer_checks.bilingual_parity: Matching 16 analytical headings, 22 exact source URLs, identical quantitative series, matched chronology, fiscal distinctions, legal conclusions and uncertainty statements.
producer_checks.methodology: Distinguish legal persons and capital stocks/flows, avoid inferring political command from funding, present contrary evidence and documented market-abuse judgment, refuse ethnic conspiracy frames.
